The '''Forbidden Falls''' was a waterfall located along the [[Tythos River]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Situated at the north end of the [[Tythos River Valley]], the Falls deposited water into a lake in the base of the valley, and a cave network behind the falls connected the valley to the ruins of an [[Ruined Tythonian city|ancient city]].
